snippet.title: Aliens & Anti-Vaxxers Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4508320/Plague_Inc_Aliens__AntiVaxxers/

Out 7th April

A meteor from outer space carries an utterly alien plague type. Humans are irrelevant - can you transform the planet into a solid crystal?

From the infinite depths of space comes an utterly alien plague type. Radically new gameplay, mysterious victory conditions, interstellar genes, haunting music and much more. The world will never be the same again.

Sometimes even an alien plague threatening the entire galaxy just isn’t enough! Well don’t worry - we have you covered with a whole host of major new scenarios that add new gameplay mechanics, mix up strategies and add new narratives. Prepare for demons, humans who are immune to your disease, endlessly marching zombies and more!
